mapper.insert: insert into ai_model_capability ( model_id, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, support_function_calling, support_vision, support_streaming, quality_score, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{modelId}, #{maxInputTokens}, #{maxOutputTokens}, #{supportFunctionCalling}, #{supportVision}, #{supportStreaming}, #{qualityScore}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update ai_model_capability set max_input_tokens = #{maxInputTokens}, max_output_tokens = #{maxOutputTokens}, support_function_calling = #{supportFunctionCalling}, support_vision = #{supportVision}, support_streaming = #{supportStreaming}, quality_score = #{qualityScore}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where model_id = #{modelId}
mapper.select: select id, model_id, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, support_function_calling, support_vision, support_streaming, quality_score, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_capability where model_id = #{modelId}
